source_clauses.verbatim: I want a wall-mounted dispenser for small items.
It should hold about twenty of them
and release exactly one each time I press a lever
so I never get two at once.
I refill it from the top without taking it off the wall.
It must not jam when it is nearly empty.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I want a wall-mounted dispenser for small items.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The product is a wall-mounted dispenser for small items.

requirements.statement_verbatim: It should hold about twenty of them
requirements.observable_verbatim: The dispenser holds approximately twenty items.

requirements.statement_verbatim: and release exactly one each time I press a lever
requirements.observable_verbatim: Pressing the lever causes exactly one item to be released.

requirements.statement_verbatim: so I never get two at once.
requirements.observable_verbatim: No more than one item is released per lever press.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I refill it from the top without taking it off the wall.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The dispenser can be refilled through its top while remaining wall-mounted.

requirements.statement_verbatim: It must not jam when it is nearly empty.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The dispenser does not jam when nearly empty.

scenarios.name: Dispensing an item
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the wall-mounted dispenser with its lever and internal storage. Outside: the wall it is mounted on, the user who presses the lever, and the small items stored inside (which enter and leave the boundary during operation).
scenarios.environment: The dispenser is mounted on a wall and the user operates it.

scenarios.name: Refilling the dispenser
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the wall-mounted dispenser and its top opening. Outside: the wall it is mounted on and the user who adds items through the top.
scenarios.environment: The dispenser stays attached to the wall during refilling.

freedoms.decision: The specific mechanism, materials, and dimensions are not specified.
freedoms.why_free: The text does not prescribe them.

freedoms.decision: The exact capacity (approximately twenty) may vary within an unspecified tolerance.
The wall type and installation method are not specified.

ambiguities.statement: The condition 'nearly empty' is not precisely defined; it is unclear at what remaining count the no-jam requirement applies.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: when the exact capacity and the behavior near the end are defined

assumptions.statement: The small items are uniform enough that the dispenser can be designed to hold and release them as described.
assumptions.why: The text assumes the items are compatible with the stated functions.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the items vary greatly in size or shape.
